# Notifications

The person does these in the Whatsable app. Give the path and the steps; never say you did it. Fetch the "Full steps" address for the exact steps, or give the person the link.

## The notification bell

- **What it is:** Notices with a link to what they are about, such as an AI handoff.
- **Plan:** Every plan.
- **Who can do it:** Everyone. AI handoffs reach everyone who can see the conversation; other notices reach owners and admins.
- **Where:** The bell at the bottom of the sidebar > Notifications
- **The agent can:** nothing here; the person does it in the app.
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/features/notifications.md, section "the-bell". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/features/notifications#the-bell

## Turn notification categories on or off

- **What it is:** Turn each notification category on or off for the whole organization.
- **Plan:** Every plan.
- **Who can do it:** Owners and admins.
- **Where:** Settings > Notification settings
- **The agent can:** nothing here; the person does it in the app.
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/features/notifications.md, section "turn-a-category-on-or-off". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/features/notifications#turn-a-category-on-or-off

## Alerts on this device

- **What it is:** Browser alerts on this device, set per person and per browser.
- **Plan:** Every plan.
- **Who can do it:** Each person, for their own browser.
- **Where:** The bell at the bottom of the sidebar > Notifications > On this device > Turn on
- **The agent can:** nothing here; the person does it in the app.
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/features/notifications.md, section "get-alerts-on-this-device". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/features/notifications#get-alerts-on-this-device
